lessons_used: Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful, winning both of its tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) was helpful, winning 1 of 2 tests.

Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info), copy changes on sign-in (sign_in, copy), and copy changes on path selection (choose_path, copy) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for all change categories tested only once.
Predictions were consistently too high for non-winning tests.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful, winning 2 of 3 tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) and redesigning adoption (adoption, redesign) were helpful, each winning 1 of 2 tests.

Path selection copy (choose_path, copy), path selection layout (choose_path, layout), home wait-time information (home, wait_info), and sign-in copy (sign_in, copy) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for all change categories tested only once.
Predictions were consistently too high for non-winning tests, while winning tests were mostly underpredicted.
